description.text: Core courses Principle of Education, General Psychology, History of Chinese Education, History of Education in Foreign Countries, Teaching Methodology, Principles of Moral Education, Child Psychology, Pedagogic Psychology, Human Anatomy and Physiology, Philosophy of Education, Educational Statistics and Its Application, Educational and Psychological Measurement, Methods of Education Research, Educational Law, Educational Administration, Educational Economics. Objective This objective is to train students to obtain good moral characters, solid pedagogic theory; have strong ability to practice pedagogy-related teaching and research; have acquaintance with the history of education in China and foreign countries and the recent development of educational reform in China and abroad. After graduation, students will be able to work in the fields of pedagogy-related teaching and research of primary and secondary education, serve as guidance advisers on psychological healthy in primary and middle schools, or as educational administrative staff or as professional personnel working in the sections of educational news, publishing or media for educational development. Meanwhile, students are trained to lay for solid foundation for further advanced studies in Principles of Education, Curriculum and Teaching Methodology, History of Education in China and Foreign Countries, Comparative Education, Foundational Education, etc. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Education is granted

duration.text: The Pedagogy at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
